assets.name: research_center_selected_concept
assets.prompt_summary: Selected option A: a blue-gray compact research station with a dominant Moai statue, copper dish, antenna and cyan windows on a magenta key background.

assets.name: research_center_iteration1
assets.prompt_summary: First imagegen-only refinement: simplify the selected structure into a strict 64x64 logical-pixel vocabulary while preserving its silhouette and statue face.

assets.name: research_center_final
assets.prompt_summary: Second targeted imagegen edit: shorten the statue and total silhouette, add logical-grid clearance, cap the subject at 58x59 logical pixels, and retain all selected architectural parts.

assets.name: research_center_final_v2
assets.prompt_summary: Third imagegen-only correction after measured rejection of a 68x68 logical subject: redraw the same design with fewer logical pixels and a target subject no larger than 56x58.

assets.name: research_center_final_v3
assets.prompt_summary: Final measured correction after reaching 60x64: remove four logical rows from the statue pedestal and facade while preserving width and identity.

assets.name: research_center_final_v4
assets.prompt_summary: Accepted low-grid redraw target: occupy about 70 percent of the image and use an explicit 50-52 by 52-54 logical subject instead of rearranging the previous 60x64 grid.

assets.name: research_center_panel_background
assets.prompt_summary: New 4:3 blue technology pixel UI plate matching the player backpack's low-medium pixel density, with blank tabs and broad empty content regions but no baked item slots or upgrade nodes.
